remarks: A ready-to-move-in condo with a great floor plan and thoughtful updates, 226 Sunrise Hill Road, Unit 226 is located in the Sunrise Hill Townhomes, a highly desirable area of Norwalk. The first floor features hardwood floors and an open entryway that flows naturally into the main living space, half bath, and updated kitchen. Upstairs are two spacious bedrooms with a full bathroom, ample closet space, and a pull down attic. The finished lower level includes an updated laundry area along with flexible space for storage, a home office, or additional living use. A private garage offers convenient parking and additional storage. Residents enjoy outdoor space and access to community amenities including a pool, tennis courts, and a playground. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, and major commuting routes.
